prompt: I want to build a VS Code extension that adds a tree view in the explorer sidebar showing all running Docker containers with colored status dots (green=running, red=stopped, yellow=pausing). Clicking a container should open its logs in a terminal. I'm on WSL with code-insiders.

assertions.name: has-package-json-views
assertions.description: package.json declares a view contribution in the explorer container

assertions.name: has-treedataprovider
assertions.description: Implements TreeDataProvider with getChildren and getTreeItem methods

assertions.name: has-colored-icons
assertions.description: Uses ThemeIcon with ThemeColor for colored status dots (green/red/yellow)

assertions.name: has-terminal-on-click
assertions.description: TreeItem click triggers terminal creation for container logs

assertions.name: has-esbuild
assertions.description: Uses esbuild for bundling, not tsc-only build

assertions.name: has-context-menus
assertions.description: Contributes menus with view/item/context entries using contextValue and when clauses for state-dependent actions

assertions.name: has-welcome-content
assertions.description: Contributes viewsWelcome content for empty state

assertions.name: has-configurable-settings
assertions.description: Contributes configuration properties (e.g., refresh interval) via contributes.configuration
